messages.subject: Markov model in INLA package
parts:
Dears INLA users,

I use the INLA package since 2016 but here I am blocked. I have 3 essential problems that break my head:

1. The implementation of Markov models in the INLA? Package. In the "survival" package, there is an option in the "Surv (.., type = mstate)" function that allows multi-event but I do not see such an option for INLA.
2. I have trouble understanding the options of the function "inla.surv ()", the help available is not very explicit. The function is written "inla.surv (time, event, time2, truncation, subject)" .. can someone help me to explain these options, please?
3. In survival analysis for recurrent events, in the "survival" package, it is possible to take into account the order of events with an "order ()" option or by writing the survival object under the form "Surv (start, stop, event)". I would like to know if there is a similar form in the INLA package to indicate the order of recurring events? My goal is to take into account SPDE spatialization for recurring events using the INLA. If anyone has a saving idea, I am a taker.

Bests regards!
Abdoulaye
